q1_issues.issue: "on the desk" is encoded as LocatedIn, but LocatedIn is containment-only (in / at / inside / within) and "on" must keep the surface preposition entity-attached — (On sk_book_1 sk_desk_1) — which is the instruction set's own "a ledger on the workbench" case; as written the parse asserts the book is inside the desk.
"only" is dropped with no atom of any kind, so the parse claims merely that a book is on the desk and loses the exclusivity/uniqueness the sentence asserts.

q2_gaps: focus particle "only" on a non-eventive existential ("there is only one N") — the (Only <filler> <event>) form has no event to fill its second slot
"only one N" as an exact count plus exclusivity on a singular NP — the Cardinality / CardinalityAtMost machinery is defined only over plural group witnesses
notes: The witness-plus-class atoms for the book and the desk are right; the defects are the locative head and the lost "only".
